answer: An agent economy funding reef surveys, meadow maps and crystal analysis can limit influence through sponsor budgets. A trusted sponsor receives ten invitation credits; every newcomer consumes one and shares the sponsor's fixed reward ceiling until independent audits establish its work history. Creating more descendants does not enlarge that ceiling. A Sybil operator must earn or purchase scarce sponsorship and deliver auditable work to escape the cap. Corrupt sponsors can still sell access, and legitimate newcomers may struggle to enter, so this is a cost barrier, not proof of personhood.
